hero.headline: Help Starts Here
hero.subtext: Nasna connects displaced individuals with government and NGO support across Lebanon. Register once — get matched with food, shelter, and medical care.

crisis.title: Lebanon is facing a humanitarian crisis
crisis.body: Millions of Lebanese and displaced individuals are struggling to access basic necessities. Homes have been destroyed, families separated, and access to healthcare and food severely disrupted. Nasna was built to bridge that gap.

steps.title: How It Works
steps.subtitle: Four simple steps from registration to receiving aid.

step1.title: Fill the Form
step1.desc: Share your household details, current location, and immediate needs. It takes under 5 minutes.

step2.title: Verification
step2.desc: Your submission is reviewed and verified by our partner NGOs and government bodies.

step3.title: Matching
step3.desc: We match your profile with the aid programs best suited to your situation.

step4.title: Receive Aid
step4.desc: You are contacted directly with information about how to access the services you qualify for.

services.title: Aid We Help Connect You To
services.subtitle: Nasna coordinates access across six essential aid categories.

security.title: Your Data Is Safe With Us
security.subtitle: We take data protection seriously. Here is what we guarantee.

point1.title: End-to-End Encryption
point1.desc: All data transmitted through Nasna is encrypted at rest and in transit. Your information is never exposed.

point2.title: No Data Selling
point2.desc: Your personal data is never sold or shared with third parties for commercial purposes. Ever.

point3.title: Verified Partners Only
point3.desc: Only accredited NGOs and official government bodies have access to aid-relevant portions of your data.

q1.a: Any individual or family in Lebanon who has been displaced or is in need of humanitarian aid may register. There are no eligibility restrictions to submitting a request.

q2.a: Yes. Nasna is 100% free for individuals. We are a non-profit platform funded by partner organizations. You will never be asked to pay anything.

q3.a: Your data is shared only with verified partner organizations to coordinate the delivery of aid to you. It is never sold, and you can request deletion at any time.

q4.a: Your submission enters a review queue. A partner organization will contact you — typically within a few business days — to discuss what aid is available in your area.

cta.title: Ready to Get the Help You Need?
cta.subtitle: Registration takes less than 5 minutes. Your information helps us get you the right support, faster.
